rules.interaction: Amounts increase every July 1; state Housing Crisis Act and the LA Resident Protections Ordinance (eff. 2025-02-11) can require higher payments for lower-income tenants displaced by demolition.
rules.coverage_conditions: No-fault evictions of RSO units; demolition for new construction of lower-income tenants of Protected Units follows the RPO Chart B instead ($87,450 to $115,480)
rules.exemptions: resident manager replaced by another manager; hazardous conditions from a natural disaster not caused by landlord negligence
rules.title: Los Angeles RSO no-fault eviction relocation assistance (Bulletin A, 2026-27)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions of RSO units within 15 days of serving the notice, per unit: eligible tenants $11,000 (under 3 years) or $14,400 (3+ years or low income); qualified tenants (62+, disabled, or with minor child) $23,150 or $27,400; reduced mom-and-pop amounts for owner or family move-in.

rules.quoted_span: Single Family Dwellings Owned by Natural Persons
rules.interaction: Relocation under the JCO is credited with, and may be topped up by, State Housing Crisis Act and RPO amounts for lower-income demolition displacement.

all.unavailable: single-family home or condominium owned by a non-corporate, non-trust owner who gave written notice of exemption

any.unavailable: transient hotel, licensed care facility, fraternity or sorority house, owner's roommate, qualifying cooperative, homeless or treatment nonprofit facility, HACLA or government property

rules.coverage_conditions: No-fault evictions of units covered by the Just Cause Ordinance
rules.exemptions: resident manager replaced by another manager; hazardous conditions from a natural disaster not caused by landlord negligence
rules.key_value: $11,000 / $14,400 eligible; $23,150 / $27,400 qualified; one month's rent for qualifying single-family (2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30)
rules.title: Los Angeles JCO no-fault eviction relocation assistance (Bulletin A, 2026-27)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions of JCO units using the same per-unit chart as the RSO ($11,000 to $27,400); a single-family dwelling owned by a natural person with no more than four units plus one single-family home owes one month's rent.

notes: Relocation Assistance Bulletins A and B (rev 2026-07-01). Chart A amounts effective 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 and rise each July 1; Bulletin B covers Resident Protections Ordinance demolition payments (Ordinances 188481 and 188482, effective 2025-02-11), folded into coverage_conditions. Fees tables and HUD income limits are not rules in the six categories. Jurisdictions' underlying section cites (151.09, 165.03, 165.06) come from the bulletin text; the instrument effective dates are not stated, so effective_date is the amount-chart date.
